# The Memory Merchant

The woman's eyes... filled with tears...

as she relived...

the memory...

of a love...

that had slipped through her fingers...

The Memory Merchant...

watched...

her pain...

and offered...

no words of comfort...

only...

a new box *the woman's gaze...

flickered...

to the box and she opened it a memory...

of a goodbye...

a heart...

broken...

*her body... shook with sobs...

the merchant's smile...

faded...

as he realized...

he had sold her a piece...

of herself...
